description: qou-d0qq, framework-side plan step 2 (candidate C3): the abelianised Cartan connection A⁰ = X dz on the colour cubic supplies NO twist on ℂ∖Δ. Push-down Σ_j X_j dz = −(z+1) dz is exact (Vieta); around every branch point the fixed sheet's circle integral and the exchanged pair's sum both vanish to 1e-30 at 50 dps (trapezoid, geometric convergence, N doubled), so the closed loop on the curve (lasso twice) has zero integral on every sheet and holonomy exp(∮A⁰) = 1. Scope (b) — invariant: holomorphy of the fixed sheet inside the circle + Vieta. The deformation 1 ↦ q₀ therefore cannot come from the framework's own abelian connection; it enters as an external twist exponent (C3′), i.e. the KZ level. Nothing reads q₀; anchor independent.
